summary: > “Don't hate the hacker, hate the code.”
> Packet is a member of the 1999 boy band On-lyne.
> The technical wizard of the band and the youngest of the group. The other members of On-lyne are very protective of Packet.
sections: The biographies of the band's members can currently be found on the official website. Clicking on a given member's picture will display a short biography. Clicking the selected portrait again surrounds it with infested growths while subsequently corrupting the biography.

Sometimes it's tough being the youngest, but Packet knows how to hold his own! He might get flustered on camera when he's nervous, but that just makes him cuter. He's into hacking and computers and stuff like that, which is pretty crazy for someone his age. He’s a total nerd and super smart, too. Packet keeps the peace between the boys, and it’s hard not to sympathize with him. He hates aggressive journalists and wishes that everyone could just get along.
